scripts.docs:build: npm run check --workspace @stoneql/docs && npm run build --workspace @stoneql/docs && node .website/scripts/check-output.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: cargo run --locked -p stoneql-contracts --example generate -- --check && tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler contracts/tests/v1.ts
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && cargo build --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol
scripts.desktop:run: npm run desktop:build && cargo run --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol
scripts.desktop:test: cargo test --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol,sqlite && cargo test --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol --test ipc
scripts.desktop:bundle:adhoc: npm run build && cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/build" tauri build --bundles app --features custom-protocol --config tauri.macos-adhoc.conf.json -- --locked
scripts.desktop:dmg:adhoc: npm run build && cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/build" tauri build --bundles app,dmg --features custom-protocol --config tauri.macos-adhoc.conf.json -- --locked
scripts.desktop:deb: npm run build && cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/build" tauri build --bundles deb --features custom-protocol --config tauri.linux-deb.conf.json -- --locked
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run desktop:build && cargo run --locked -p stoneql-desktop --features custom-protocol -- --smoke-test
scripts.test:receive-limit: node tools/prepare-receive-limit.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path experiments/sqlx-receive-limit/Cargo.toml --target-dir target/receive-limit && cargo test --locked --manifest-path experiments/sqlx-receive-limit/Cargo.toml --target-dir target/receive-limit -p sqlx-mysql receive_limit_tests
